findings.evidence: `TauCeti/RepresentationTheory/Induction/Transitivity.lean:39-47` defines `Rep.resFunctorCompIso φ ψ : Rep.resFunctor ψ ⋙ Rep.resFunctor φ ≅ Rep.resFunctor (ψ.comp φ)` by identity components; the new theorem at `Restriction.lean:67-69` states exactly the corresponding functor equality in the reverse orientation.
findings.fix: Make `Transitivity.lean` import this infrastructure and define `Rep.resFunctorCompIso φ ψ` from `eqToIso (resFunctor_comp ψ φ).symm` (adjusting universes as needed), retaining its component lemmas rather than independently rebuilding the natural isomorphism.
findings.issue: `resFunctor_comp` duplicates the semantic content of the existing `TauCeti.Rep.resFunctorCompIso`, leaving parallel equality and natural-isomorphism APIs for the same restriction composition.

summary: The PR introduces a second API for restriction-in-stages without consolidating the existing TauCeti construction.
